P.name: Glorious Evolution
P.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} '''Viktor''' can augment each of his {{tip|abilities}} at the cost of 100 ''Hex Fragments'', which he gains from killing enemies:
* {{tip|Minions}} and {{tip|monsters}} generate 1 ''Hex Fragment''.
* Siege minions, super minions, and epic monsters generate 10 ''Hex Fragments''.
* Enemy {{tip|champion}} {{tip|takedown|takedowns}} generate 20 ''Hex Fragments''.
P.description2: ''{{ai|Arcane Storm|Viktor}}'' can be augmented after all of '''Viktor's''' basic abilities have been augmented.

Q.name: Siphon Power
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Viktor''' throws a draining device at the target enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}}. He also grants himself a {{tip|shield}} for {{pp|40 to 140}} {{as|(+ 25% AP)}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds and gains ''Discharge'' for 4 seconds.
Q.description2: {{sbc|Discharge:}} '''Viktor's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} is empowered to become {{tip|projectile|non-projectile}} and deal {{as|'''modified''' magic damage}}.
Q.leveling2:
{{st|Modified Magic Damage|{{ap|20 to 120}} {{as|(+ 100% AD)}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}}}
{{st|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|60+20 to 120+120}} {{as|(+ 100% AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40+50}}% AP)}}}}
Q.description3: {{Anchor|Augment: Turbocharge}}{{sbc|{{ai|Glorious Evolution|Viktor|Augment: Turbocharge}} — }} After the device hits, '''Viktor''' gains {{sti|ms|{{as|30% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds and the shield's strength is increased{{ft|by 60%.|to {{pp|40*1.6 to 140*1.6}} {{as|(+ {{ap|25*1.6}}% AP)}}.}}

Q.description2: {{sbc|Discharge:}} '''Viktor's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} is empowered to become {{tip|projectile|non-projectile}} and deal {{as|'''modified''' magic damage}}.

W.name: Gravity Field
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Viktor''' deploys a gravity field at the target location for {{fd|4.5}} seconds. After a {{fd|0.75}}-second delay, it activates to {{tip|slow}} enemies within for 1 second, refreshing every {{fd|0.25}} seconds while they remain inside.
W.description2: The field applies a {{tip|stack}} of ''Heavy Gravity'' to enemies within every {{fd|0.25}} seconds, stacking up to 5 times. The fifth stack consumes them all to {{tip|knockdown|knock down}} and {{tip|stun}} the target for {{fd|1.5}} seconds. The knockdown and stun can be triggered only once per cast per enemy.
W.description3: {{Anchor|Augment: Magnetize}}{{sbc|{{ai|Glorious Evolution|Viktor|Augment: Magnetize}} — }} '''Viktor's''' other abilities, excluding ''{{ais|Arcane Storm|Viktor}}'' persistent damage, {{tip|slow}} enemies hit by 20% for 1 second.

E.name: Hextech Ray
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Viktor''' fires an energy beam along the target path that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and briefly grants {{tip|sight}} of the area.
E.description2: {{Anchor|Augment: Aftershock}}{{sbc|{{ai|Glorious Evolution|Viktor|Augment: Aftershock}} — }} The path explodes along the beam's wake after 1 second, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.
E.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|20 to 140}} {{as|(+ 80% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|70+20 to 230+140}} {{as|(+ 130% AP)}}}}

R.name: Arcane Storm
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Viktor''' conjures an arcane singularity at the target location, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within the area and {{tip|disrupt|disrupting}} their {{tip|channel|channeled abilities}}.
R.description2: The singularity then remains active as a moving storm for {{fd|6.5}} seconds, striking a bolt of electricity onto enemies within it every second to deal {{as|magic damage}}, as well as granting {{tip|sight}} of the area within its radius and the {{tt|surrounding area|If radius is below 700 units}}. The singularity will target the nearest champion hit by its initial damage and will follow them. The singularity moves faster based on its proximity to '''Viktor'''.
R.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage Per Tick|{{ap|65 to 145}} {{as|(+ 35% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|100+65*6 to 250+145*6}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50+35*6}}% AP)}}}}
R.description3: ''Arcane Storm'' can be recast at any time while the singularity is active.
R.description4: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Viktor''' directs the singularity to the target location, or to follow the target enemy champion or himself for its remaining duration.
R.description5: {{Anchor|Augment: Perfect Storm}}{{sbc|{{ai|Glorious Evolution|Viktor|Augment: Perfect Storm}} — }} The singularity moves 25% faster. Additionally, whenever an enemy champion is {{tip|takedown|taken down}} after being damaged by ''Arcane Storm'', the storm's size is increased by 40% and its duration is extended by 3 seconds. The storm's radius can be increased up to 6 times and the duration can be extended only up to the original duration.
R.description6: ''Arcane Storm's recast can be used while affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}.''
